fusions.name: Thorn Prick
fusions.desc: A thorned jab that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Taproot Sweep
fusions.desc: From a rooted stance, deals 13 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaves them [Pinned] for 2 seconds. Your afflictions on each enemy hit spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Rooted Breathing
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Years of Growth
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
